page.layout: One printed page: a verb paradigm set in lines and columns. Left, the row labels (Infinitū, Præsens, Perfectū, Futurū). Right of them, three columns of Greek forms under each tense or mood heading. Running head centred at top, page number at top left. A catchword-like fragment "Futu-" at the lower right is the start of the next section's heading. No marginal notes; faint show-through from the other side on the right is left out.
page.notes: Greek forms are copied from a small, faint scan; accents and breathings in several places are uncertain and are not marked individually, so treat the Greek as approximate. Forms with [?] are doubtful. The Greek letters of the Optative and Perfect rows are partly obscured by the printing. Faint show-through from the reverse side on the right margin is not transcribed. The last line "Futu-" is the catchword leading into the next page.
